_about: Refine, seventh pass (2026-11-24): words left over from the old Goal on other pages. A Goal runs on its chat's persona and model and never uses a crew (GRS-049, GRS-052), so the model group is for helpers and small jobs, and a crew works on a job. The Planning page's More options line names the stricter-proof group that moved there.
